articles.title: IN-SPACe selects five space technology use-cases by non-government entities for funding
articles.summary: IN-SPACe has selected five innovative space technology projects from non-government entities under its seed fund scheme. This initiative aims to bolster India's burgeoning private space sector by providing crucial funding. It signifies a significant step towards fostering indigenous innovation and expanding national capabilities in the space domain, driving India's progress in advanced technology.
